title: E-QTM-0044: the measurement-selection obstruction (shared with the three-generation distinction) is resolved in...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0044 in the quantum arena: the measurement-selection obstruction (shared with the three-generation distinction) is resolved in principle by spontaneous symmetry breaking: below a critical point an infinitesimal bias selects a definite branch and the susceptibility diverges, while above it (the symmetric phase E-QTM-0043 tested) nothing is selected, and the model has such a transition (E-GRV-0035).
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
